summary: Share bar for articles and events: a “Share” button that opens the system’s native share sheet (where available), share links for LinkedIn, X, Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram, Bluesky, and email, and a “Copy link” button with an announced confirmation.
whenToUse: At the end of or next to the title of an article, event, or talk.
On the registration confirmation page, to invite other attendees.
whenNotToUse: Links to the community’s profiles: use SocialLinks.
Copying a value that isn’t a link (token, command): use CopyButton.

props.name: title
props.description: Title: email subject and fallback text for X, Telegram, WhatsApp, and Bluesky.

props.name: networks
props.description: Networks to show, in order. Mastodon is not included: there is no universal share URL (it depends on the instance).

props.name: showNativeShare
props.description: “Share” button that opens navigator.share; appears only after mount and only where the API exists.

props.name: showCopy
props.description: “Copy link” button (useCopyToClipboard) with the result in a polite live region.

props.name: variant
props.description: icon: round icon-only buttons; pill: icon + name.

props.name: tone
props.description: Same as SocialLinks; inverse for dark sections.

props.name: onShare
props.description: For analytics: link pressed, native share completed, or link copied.

inherits: HTML attributes of the <div> (id, style, data-*); ref to the role="group" container.

keyboard.action: Moves from one button to the next.
Opens the share link or activates the button.

accessibility: role="group" container with a name (“Share” by default).
Each link is named messages.shareOn(network), e.g. “Share on LinkedIn”, plus “(opens in a new tab)”; in pill, the visible name is contained in the accessible name.
“Copy link” becomes “Link copied” and the result (including errors) is announced by a role="status" live region.
The native button is detected after mount: no difference between the server HTML and the first render.
Decorative icons; 44 px targets on touch, no transitions with prefers-reduced-motion, system colors in forced-colors mode.
responsive: Buttons wrap in narrow containers; on mobile the native button offers all installed apps.
customization: Uses the same styles and tokens as SocialLinks (.dc-social-links-link[data-network|data-target]).
getShareUrl(network, { url, title, text }) is a pure function for building the same URLs elsewhere (menus, emails).
commonMistakes: Passing a relative URL: networks require absolute URLs.
Showing too many networks: pick the ones your audience actually uses and leave the rest to the native button.
Expecting onShare after the actual post: for links it only indicates that the share page was opened.

examples.name: Pill
examples.title: Pills and more networks
examples.description: pill variant, size sm, custom group name.

limits: Mastodon is not supported: it requires knowing the user’s instance.
No official brand logos: generic icons from lucide-react.
The native button does not appear in the first render (detected after mount).
